entities.summary: Cheikh Moussa Diagné Ly is a Senegalese professional basketball player for Iberostar Tenerife of the Liga ACB. He is a center, but he can also play as a power forward. He was listed as one of the top international prospects for the 2015 NBA draft, but went undrafted.
